dedupe_keys.name: scigrid open source reference model of european transmission networks for scientific analysis

description: SciGrid: Open Source Reference Model of European Transmission Networks for Scientific Analysis is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by DLR Institute of Networked Energy Systems (DLR-VE). Providing transmission network datasets for Europe including its nodes (electrical substations) and edges (transmission lines) at the transmission level (above 220 kV). Coverage: Germany. Methodical focus: automated network model. Spatial resolution: national states, TSO regions, regions, NUTS 3, power stations. Software: Python, PostgreSQL, osmosis. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Academic Free License v3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
